【シンシナティ=共同】米大リーグは20日、各地で行われ、カブスの鈴木はシンシナティでのレッズ戦に「2番・右翼」で出場し、18試合ぶりの本塁打となる25号ソロを放つなど5打数1安打1打点だった。チームは9-1で快勝した。
ブルージェイズの岡本は、7-2で勝ったレンジャーズ戦に「4番・三塁」で先発し、勝ち越し適時打を放って5打数1安打1打点。ロッキーズの菅野はマリナーズ戦に先発し、5回1安打1失点で11敗目（12勝）を喫した。試合は1-2。
ホワイトソックスの村上はタイガース戦に「4番・一塁」で出場。
アストロズの今井はブレーブス戦の八回から2回を投げ、無安打無失点。4-2で勝ったブレーブスが3年ぶりのナ・リーグ東地区優勝を決めた。吉田が負傷者リスト（IL）入りしているレッドソックスはレイズに1-5で屈したものの、2年連続のプレーオフ進出が決まった。
メッツの千賀はフィリーズ戦の八回に登板し、1/3回を2安打3失点だった。試合は2-7で負けた。大谷がIL入りしているドジャースはジャイアンツ戦。

item.content:encoded:
After going 0-for-10 with four strikeouts in the first two games of this series, Cubs center fielder Pete Crow-Armstrong had himself another big day in the third contest. PCA singled, doubled, homered and stole a base and helped lead the Cubs to a 9-1 blowout of the Reds, a victory tempered by a freak injury to Alex Bregman. More on the latter anon, first let’s wrap this win.
The Cubs got on the board in the first inning. PCA led off the game with a single and stole second, his 38th [VIDEO].
The Cubs extended their lead in the third. PCA led off with a double. A note on that double from BCB’s JohnW53:
With his third-inning double, Pete Crow-Armstrong has at least 30 homers, doubles and steals.
Only one Cub had done that before: PCA, last year.
Forty players on other teams have done it, 12 of them also multiple times. PCA is among 10 with two. Alfonso Soriano did it four times; Barry Bonds and Jose Ramirez, three.
It was noted on the Marquee broadcast that PCA’s 40-HR, 30-double, 30-steal year is the first ever by a MLB center fielder — nope, not Willie Mays, not Ken Griffey Jr., no one, until now. I’ve said it before, but don’t ever forget what you are seeing from Pete this year — it is truly historic.
Anyway, PCA then went to third on a ground out by Seiya Suzuki. The Cubs then loaded the bases on walks drawn by Michael Busch and Bregman.
Per the Marquee broadcast, that’s 22 bases-loaded walks for the Cubs this year, the most in MLB.
With the bases still loaded, Michael Conforto struck out, but Pedro Ramirez followed with a two-run single to make it 5-0 [VIDEO].
Now to the Bregman incident in the fourth inning. With two out, Busch hit a foul ball that struck Bregman, who was in the on-deck circle, in the face. Bregman immediately left the game and was replaced by Matt Shaw. Here’s what that looked like [VIDEO].
Per Craig Counsell’s postgame remarks, the ball hit Bregman in the cheekbone, which is swollen. There was also a facial cut, but we don’t know anything beyond that. Hopefully it’s not too serious and Bregman doesn’t have a concussion.
While all this was going on, David Peterson was sailing along, striking out seven over the first four innings. The Reds made it 5-1 on a solo homer by JJ Bleday in the fourth.
The Cubs got that run right back in the fifth on a solo homer by Michael Conforto, his 15th [VIDEO].
If you’re keeping track:
Kyle Tucker, 16 HR, 515 AB
Michael Conforto, 15 HR, 294 AB
That blast tied PCA with Kyle Schwarber for the MLB lead. The Cubs also lead MLB in home runs with 217; as noted on the Marquee broadcast, the last time the Cubs led all of baseball in home runs was 1958, led by Ernie Banks with 47 in his first MVP season.
Peterson completed six innings, allowing three hits and just the one run on Bleday’s homer. Here are his seven strikeouts [VIDEO].
More on Peterson’s afternoon from BCB’s JohnW53:
David Peterson’s quality start was his fifth as a Cub, fourth most on the team. Shota Imanaga has 14, as many as the next two combined: Matthew Boyd, eight, and Colin Rea, six. Edward Cabrera and Jameson Taillon both have four. Five others have one to three.
Peterson could be a valuable weapon in the postseason, either as a starter or out of the bullpen.
The Cubs weren’t done homering, either. After Caleb Thielbar threw a scoreless seventh, Suzuki lofted his 25th into the batter’s eye to make it 9-1 [VIDEO].
More on recent Cubs home runs from John:
With their three home runs, the Cubs have hit nine in their last four games (three, one, two, three). They had hit 12 in their previous 14 games, since smacking a team-record nine at home vs. the Brewers on Aug. 31.
Edward Cabrera was given the eighth inning, a good low-leverage situation. He allowed a leadoff single and after retiring the next hitter, another Reds batter reached on an error by Ramirez. But Cabrera got Elly De La Cruz to hit into an inning-ending double play.
Colin Rea finished up with a 1-2-3 ninth, his first game action in 11 days, on just eight pitches. Here’s the final out [VIDEO].
The Cubs will clinch a postseason berth if the Yankees defeat the Diamondbacks Sunday, a game that’s just begun at the time of this recap. The Padres, tied with the Cubs for the top wild card spot with the Cubs holding the tiebreaker, are playing the Marlins in a contest in San Diego that’s also just underway. The Phillies defeated the Mets Sunday, so the Cubs still lead Philadelphia by a game. Thanks to the Mets for taking two of the four games from the Phillies over the weekend.
The Cubs have Monday off, then open the final regular season home series Tuesday evening against the Marlins at Wrigley Field. Kevin Gausman will start for the Cubs and Janson Junk will go for Miami. Game time Tuesday is 6:40 p.m. CT and TV coverage will be via Marquee Sports Network.

CHICAGO (Kyodo) -- Seiya Suzuki collected two hits, including a run-scoring single, as the Chicago Cubs defeated the Cincinnati Reds 5-2 on Saturday.
Batting third as the designated hitter, Suzuki went 2-for-3 with an RBI at Great American Ball Park.
"Although I wasn't waiting for (a changeup), I was able to get the bat on it," Suzuki said.
"The quality of my outs hadn't been very good lately, so my swings probably looked hesitant, but I was able to swing the bat in good form today."
Munetaka Murakami hit an RBI single to open the scoring as the Chicago White Sox beat the Detroit Tigers 3-1.
The Japanese slugger, who has hit 32 home runs in his MLB rookie season, went 1-for-4 with an RBI at Rate Field.
Meanwhile, Kazuma Okamoto singled to finish 1-for-4 as the Toronto Blue Jays lost to the Texas Rangers 6-2.

item.content:encoded:
【カブス5-2レッズ】シンシナティ／グレートアメリカンボールパーク、9月19日（日本時間20日）
熾烈なワイルドカード争いを繰り広げているカブスは敵地でのレッズ3連戦の2戦目。五回に鈴木誠也のタイムリーでリードを2点に広げた直後、レッズの反撃に遭って同点に追いつかれたものの、六回にマイケル・ブッシュの20号ソロで勝ち越すと、終盤にも追加点を奪い、5-2で勝利した。ワイルドカード争いで4番手につけるダイヤモンドバックスの結果次第ではあるが、早ければ20日（同21日）にもポストシーズン進出が決定する。 カブスは二回、先頭のニコ・ホーナーの二塁打から1死一、三塁とチャンスを広げ、マット・ショウの犠牲フライで1点を先制。先発のマシュー・ボイドが好投を続ける中、五回には2死三塁の場面で鈴木誠也がレフトへのタイムリーを放ち、2-0とリードを広げた。 ボイドは五回、先頭のエウヘニオ・スアレスに四球を与えると、1死後にJJ・ブレデイにライトへのヒットを浴び、遊撃手ダンズビー・スワンソンの送球エラーが絡んで1失点。2死後、キブライアン・ヘイズにセンターへのタイムリーを許し、2-2の同点に追いつかれた（ボイドの自責点は1）。 しかし、続く六回にブッシュの20号ソロが飛び出し、勝ち越しに成功。2番手のダニエル・パレンシアが2イニングをパーフェクトに抑える好リリーフを見せると、八回にはホーナーのタイムリーで貴重な追加点を奪った。 3番手のアーロン・シバーリは八回に2死一、二塁のピンチを招いたが、4番手のライアン・ゼファージャンがサル・スチュワートを空振り三振に仕留めて無失点。九回にはスワンソンの19号ソロでダメ押しの5点目を奪い、最終回はゼファージャンから5番手のライアン・ロリソンにつなぐ継投でレッズの反撃を封じ、5-2で勝利した。 鈴木は「3番・DH」でスタメン出場。初回の第1打席は四球を選んで出塁し、三回の第2打席はライトへのヒットを放った。五回の第3打席は2死三塁のチャンスでレフトへのタイムリー。八回の先頭打者として迎えた第4打席は空振り三振に倒れ、3打数2安打1打点1四球だった。今季の打撃成績は打率.267、OPS.833となっている。

item.description: ● レッズ 2－5 カブス ○ ＜現地時間9月19日 グレートアメリカン・ボールパーク＞ シカゴ・カブスが同地区カード2戦目に勝利し、ポストシーズン進出へマジック「2」。鈴木誠也外野手（32）は「3番・指名打者」でフル出場し、2安打1打点の活躍を収めた。 鈴木は先発左腕ロドロに対して第1打席で四球、第2打席は右前安打。1点リードの5回表には二死三塁の好機で第3打席を迎えると、外角低めのチェンジアップを捉えて左前適時打とし、2試合連続打点をマークした。 カブスは5回裏に2対2の同点に追い付かれるも、直後の6回表に6番マイケル・ブッシュの20号ソロで再勝ち越し。8回表に5番ニコ・ホーナーの中前適時打、9回表には9番ダンズビー・スワンソンの19号ソロと効果的に追加点を挙げた。6回以降はリリーフ4投手の継投でゼロを並べ、同地区カードを1勝1敗のタイに戻した。 鈴木は3打数2安打、1打点、1四球、1三振の内容で、今季成績は打率.267、24本塁打、84打点、OPS.833。「40本塁打－40盗塁」達成まで残り3盗塁としているピート・クローアームストロングは前日に続いて5打数無安打に終わった。

カブスは5回裏に2対2の同点に追い付かれるも、直後の6回表に6番マイケル・ブッシュの20号ソロで再勝ち越し。8回表に5番ニコ・ホーナーの中前適時打、9回表には9番ダンズビー・スワンソンの19号ソロと効果的に追加点を挙げた。6回以降はリリーフ4投手の継投でゼロを並べ、同地区カードを1勝1敗のタイに戻した。
鈴木は3打数2安打、1打点、1四球、1三振の内容で、今季成績は打率.267、24本塁打、84打点、OPS.833。「40本塁打－40盗塁」達成まで残り3盗塁としているピート・クローアームストロングは前日に続いて5打数無安打に終わった。

item.content:encoded:
AP
CINCINNATI (AP) — Jose Trevino lined a two-run single to right field with the bases loaded in the sixth inning and the Cincinnati Reds rallied for a 6-4 victory over the Chicago Cubs on Friday night.
Michael Conforto had three hits for the Cubs, who are tied with the Padres and Phillies at 85-69 for the three National League wild cards — five games ahead of Arizona with eight to play.
Chicago had the potential tying run at the plate with two outs in the ninth when Michael Busch was caught stealing second base by Trevino on a pitchout.
Clay Holmes (6-8) went 5 1/3 innings for the Cubs and allowed six runs.
Eugenio Suárez tied it at 4 with a base hit to drive in Elly De La Cruz. Héctor Rodríguez grounded into a fielder's choice as Tyler Stephenson was called out at home before Trevino came through with the go-ahead hit.
De La Cruz also drove in two runs for the Reds, who dropped three of four to the Los Angeles Dodgers in their previous series.
Ian Happ homered in the third to tie it at 2 and Seiya Suzuki had a two-run single with the bases loaded in the fourth to put the Cubs up 4-3.
Julian Aguiar (2-1) got the win in relief, allowing two runs in three innings. All-Star starter Chase Burns, who is on an innings restriction, gave up two runs in three innings.
A matchup of left-handers on Saturday. Matthew Boyd (8-5, 4.16 ERA) takes the mound for Chicago while Nick Lodolo (3-5, 5.12) goes for Cincinnati.
___
This story has been corrected to show that Trevino’s two-run single came in the sixth inning, not the seventh.

CINCINNATI, Ohio – The Chicago Cubs today reinstated infielder Dansby Swanson from the 10-day injured list. In a corresponding move, infielder BJ Murray, Jr. was optioned to Triple-A Iowa.
- Pete Crow-Armstrong44
- Alex Bregman26
- Seiya Suzuki24
- Ian Happ23
- Michael Busch19
- Dansby Swanson18
- Michael Conforto14
- Carson Kelly10
Swanson, 32, was placed on the 10-day injured list on August 17 with a left oblique strain. Prior to his placement on the IL, Swanson was hitting .216 (87-for-403) with 16 doubles, three triples, 18 home runs, 66 RBI and 17 stolen bases. His 16 outs above average rank fourth in the majors and second in the National League. This was Swanson’s first IL stint since May 2024 (right knee sprain).
Murray Jr., 26, made his major league debut on September 1 and, in seven games with the Cubs, tallied one hit in 11 at-bats.
The Cubs play the Cincinnati Reds today at 5:40 p.m. CT at Great American Ball Park in a game that can be seen on Marquee Sports Network and heard on 104.3 the Score.
